title.narrative: UNICE provided technical and financial support to the PHCI to jointly plan, implement and oversee maternal and child health programs throughthe endorsement of a comprehensive work plan endorsed by the ministry of health. This collaboration and coordination helped in designing theMaternal, Newborn and Child health package being implemented in 21 additional health facilities and providing services to around 1.5 millionpopulation. Also, this partnership and coordination with the PHCI has positioned UNICEF in a very good position to co-lead the MoH ledimplementation of the Integrated Management of Newborn and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) reaching around 37,800 children under 5 years of age.
